findings.comment: Transformer Pads 4 and 5 lack minimum 10-foot hot-stick use area clearance to adjacent buildings. Pad 4 measured at 7.6 feet from Building 7 eastern wall; Pad 5 measured at 9.2 feet from Building 4 eastern wall. Both are below the 10-foot minimum required clearance for hot-stick operation.

Retaining walls are present on the site plan, but clearance from transformer pads to retaining wall faces is not dimensioned on any sheet. Cannot verify 5-foot minimum clearance from available documentation.

No building elevation drawings or cross-sections provided showing balconies, overhangs, or projections above or adjacent to transformer pads. Cannot verify 5-foot lateral clearance requirement from available documents.

Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) not specified on plans. No building elevations provided showing window, door, or ventilating duct locations relative to transformer pads. Cannot verify 12-foot clearance requirement for oil-filled equipment from available documents.

Sidewalk locations are shown on site plan near transformer pads, but clearance dimensions from transformer pad edges to sidewalk back edges are not provided. Cannot verify 2-foot minimum clearance requirement from available documentation.

One private fire hydrant shown on fire protection plan, but clearance dimensions from hydrant to transformer pads are not provided. Cannot verify 5-foot minimum clearance requirement from available documentation.

Trees are shown on landscape plan and listed on tree list, but specific tree species and their spatial proximity to individual transformer pad locations are not clearly correlated. Cannot verify that trees within 10 lateral feet of transformer pads are utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F from available documentation.

applicableAreas: Landscaped areas adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows plantings around the site, but specific shrub/low-lying vegetation locations are not dimensioned relative to individual transformer pads. Additionally, transformer pad access door orientations are not marked on electrical plan, preventing verification of 10-foot access door side and 5-foot other side clearance requirements.

applicableAreas: Areas with proposed trees within 20 feet of transformers
findings.comment: Trees are shown on landscape plan, but root barrier details and specifications are not provided. Tree proximity to transformer pad locations is not clearly documented, preventing verification of 20-foot lateral distance and root barrier requirement (4 feet deep, 5 feet from equipment) from available documentation.
Bicycle parking is shown on site plan, but clearance dimensions from bike racks to transformer pads are not provided. Cannot verify 5-foot minimum clearance requirement from available documentation.

Light poles are shown on electrical and site plans near transformer locations, but clearance dimensions from light poles to transformer pads are not dimensioned. Cannot verify 5-foot minimum clearance requirement from available documentation.

Fire lanes are designated and marked on fire protection plan, but clearance dimensions from fire lane edges to transformer pads are not provided. Cannot verify 15-foot minimum clearance requirement from available documentation.

Five transformer pads are shown on electrical plan, but clearance distances between the pads are not dimensioned. Cannot verify 5-foot minimum clearance between transformer pads from available documentation.

Water service lines are shown on utility plan, but horizontal clearance dimensions from transformer pads to water line centerlines or edges are not provided. Cannot verify 5-foot minimum horizontal clearance requirement from available documentation.

Wastewater service lines are shown on utility plan, but horizontal clearance dimensions from transformer pads to wastewater line centerlines or edges are not provided. Cannot verify 5-foot minimum horizontal clearance requirement from available documentation.

Storm drain lines are shown on storm sewer and utility plans, but horizontal clearance dimensions from transformer pads to storm drain line centerlines or edges are not provided. Cannot verify 5-foot minimum horizontal clearance requirement from available documentation.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations with underground utilities
findings.comment: Multiple underground utility lines (water, wastewater, storm drain, electric) are shown crossing or near the site, but specific horizontal and vertical clearance dimensions from transformer pads to these utilities are not provided. Cannot verify 12-inch minimum horizontal and vertical clearance requirement from available documentation.

Overhead electric line is shown on electrical and site plans near the property, but horizontal sky-to-ground clearance dimensions from transformer pads to overhead conductors are not provided. Cannot verify 7.5-foot minimum clearance requirement from available documentation.

Overhead electric distribution lines are shown on site plan, but 15-foot radius clearance zones (measured from conductors, not pole centerline) are not marked or dimensioned around transformer pad locations. Cannot verify 15-foot radius clearance requirement from available documentation.

No cross-section or profile drawings provided showing vertical clearances above transformer pad locations. Overhead structures, building overhangs, or enclosed access paths are not profiled. Required cross-section drawings demonstrating vertical clearance compliance from overhead structures are not included in the plan set.

Equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified on electrical plan. Grading plan does not show surface drainage slopes or flow direction around individual transformer pad locations. Cannot verify that liquid drainage flows away from buildings as required for oil-filled equipment from available documentation.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations in or near easement areas
findings.comment: Transformer pads appear to be positioned near drainage easements, sidewalk easements, and wastewater easements (visible on electrical plan as dashed easement boundaries), but the specific relationship of each pad to prohibited easement areas is not clearly documented. Cannot verify that pads are not located in drainage, water, sewer, or overhead electrical easements without Austin Energy Design written approval from available documentation.

No transformer easement exhibit or dedicated easement areas are shown around individual transformer pads on the electrical plan. Austin Energy Design accessibility and maintenance easements around transformer pad locations are not depicted or dimensioned. Required transformer easement documentation is not provided in the plan set.

Transformer pad dimensions (length x width) are not provided on electrical plan. No Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are included in plan set. Service type (single-phase vs. three-phase) is not specified. Cannot verify that transformer pad dimensions match Austin Energy Design-approved specifications for the specified service type from available documentation.
